description:
NinjaTrader 8 is running on the Windows desktop with real daily OHLCV data already imported for SPY (S&P 500 ETF) covering January 2023 through December 2024 (502 trading days from Yahoo Finance).

A quantitative analyst needs to evaluate the performance of a moving average crossover strategy on SPY over this two-year period, and export the trade-by-trade results for analysis in a spreadsheet.

Your task: Use the Strategy Analyzer to backtest the built-in SampleMACrossOver strategy on SPY with daily bars, covering the full available date range (January 2023 through December 2024). After the backtest completes and results are displayed, export the complete list of executed trades to a file at:
  C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\NinjaTraderTasks\spy_backtest_trades.csv

The exported file should contain the individual trade entries and exits generated by the strategy.

Login credentials: Docker / GymAnything123!
